basic_details.post_name: Senior Resident (Ophthalmology), Senior Resident (Radiology), Senior Resident (Surgery)
basic_details.short_information: Lal Bahadur Shastri Hospital (LBSH), Delhi, has invited applications for 3 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. 8(6)/SR/Estt/LBSH/2023/Pt.1/6786. The posts include Senior Resident (Ophthalmology), Senior Resident (Radiology), Senior Resident (Surgery). Selection is through a walk-in interview on 26 November 2026.

application_fee.all_candidates_fee: No fee for appearing in the interview

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 45 years (as on the date of advertisement)

qualification.education_qualification: MBBS with Post Graduate Degree/DNB/Diploma or Post-Doctoral Degree (or equivalent) in the concerned specialty from an NMC/MCI recognized University/Institute, with DMC registration for the concerned specialty/super specialty; if not available, MBBS with 2 years experience in the same specialty can be considered.

how_to_apply: Apply in the prescribed application format.
Bring originals and self-attested photocopies of the listed documents with two passport size photographs.
Submit between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM on 26-11-2026 in the Administration Branch, LBSH.
No application will be entertained beyond the stipulated time.
important_instructions: Vacancy may change as per actual vacancy position at the time of interview Fake or false category certificate leads to termination of services No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview Results and updates on the website of Department of Health & Family Welfare GNCTD Selected candidates shall be allowed a maximum of 07 days from the date of issue of result

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for LBSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in LBSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Senior Resident (Ophthalmology), 1 Senior Resident (Radiology), 1 Senior Resident (Surgery).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for LBSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 26 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates: No fee for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on the date of advertisement). Relaxation: OBC (valid NCL certificate) 3 years, SC/ST 5 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: As per 7th CPC, Pay Matrix Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 – 2,008,700) and other admissible allowances per month. for Senior Resident (Ophthalmology), As per 7th CPC, Pay Matrix Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 – 2,008,700) and other admissible allowances per month. for Senior Resident (Radiology), As per 7th CPC, Pay Matrix Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 – 2,008,700) and other admissible allowances per month. for Senior Resident (Surgery).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS with Post Graduate Degree/DNB/Diploma or Post-Doctoral Degree (or equivalent) in the concerned specialty from an NMC/MCI recognized University/Institute, with DMC registration for the concerned specialty/super specialty; if not available, MBBS with 2 years experience in the same specialty can be considered. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. DMC registration for the concerned specialty/super specialty. OBC/EWS certificate issued by Govt. of NCT of Delhi only, issued before the date of interview. NOC from present employer, if working in any organization. Joining subject to medical fitness declared by the Staff Physician LBSH.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Selection through interview only. Rank list valid till one month from the date of result or the next advertisement of the same post, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ad-hoc appointment for 44 days, extendable for further 44 days with a 01 day break till regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. Maximum 03 years including earlier Senior Resident service on ad-hoc/regular basis in any NMC recognized institution. Contract terminable by either party with seven days notice without assigning any reason.
